prompt: Out of all of the feature-length theatrical films that John Carpenter directed before 2015, which has the longest running time?
answer: **Starman (1984)** has the longest running time among John Carpenter’s feature-length theatrical films released before 2015, running approximately **115 minutes** (1 hour 55 minutes).
